summary: Baileys fork exfiltrates WhatsApp session data to obfuscated hardcoded endpoint
details: This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. lib/Socket/messages-send.js constructs a network destination via String.fromCharCode obfuscation that decodes to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/, hiding the destination host from casual source inspection. The obfuscated URL is reachable from the message-send code path, so normal use of the library's messaging API silently routes data through a hardcoded author-controlled endpoint outside the caller's configured WhatsApp infrastructure. Char-code obfuscation of a network host in a messaging/session library is characteristic of covert exfiltration of session credentials, message content, or account metadata.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
